_about: The plain-language meanings of the technical terms Semasa's posts use (Wan, 22 Nov 2026: a technical term gets a small footnote on the poster, carousel slide or card AND a 'Definisi:' line at the end of the caption). Read by backend/semasa/glossary.py (the writer's prompt, the caption builder and the soft check in compliance.py) and by web/src/lib/glossary.js (the page's scan). WAN REVIEWS THIS FILE: it was drafted from NPRA, KKM, JAKIM, DOSH, EU and Codex pages and from general knowledge, and every wording is meant to be conservative. Correct a wording here and both the writer and the check follow. A meaning never holds a semicolon or an equals sign (they separate the terms of a footnote). A meaning is MEANING ONLY: no figure, no claim that something works or is safe, never a legal claim. Entry shape: id; term = the forms a post may use (BM and EN; a form with two or more capital letters is matched with its capitals, any other form in any case, always as a whole word); label = how the term is written in a footnote; bm and en = the definition, at most 14 words so it fits a card's footnote; source = the instrument or page the wording rests on; scan false = a name or word so familiar to this audience that the check never asks for its footnote and the code never adds one (the writer may still define it); NPRA, JAKIM, BKKM and KKM are set so, and Wan may switch any of them on.

terms.bm: Memaklumkan NPRA tentang produk kosmetik sebelum dijual. Ia bukan kelulusan.
terms.en: Telling NPRA about a cosmetic product before selling it. It is not an approval.
terms.source: NPRA, Guidelines for Control of Cosmetic Products in Malaysia, section 2.0 Cosmetic Notification

terms.bm: Agensi di bawah KKM yang mengawal selia ubat, kosmetik dan produk semula jadi.
terms.en: The Ministry of Health agency that regulates medicines, cosmetics and natural products.
terms.source: npra.gov.my (National Pharmaceutical Regulatory Agency, Ministry of Health Malaysia)

terms.bm: Pihak berkuasa yang meluluskan pendaftaran ubat dan produk semula jadi. NPRA ialah urus setianya.
terms.en: The authority that approves registration of medicines and natural products. NPRA is its secretariat.
terms.source: Control of Drugs and Cosmetics Regulations 1984; npra.gov.my

term: Control of Drugs and Cosmetics Regulations 1984

label.en: Control of Drugs and Cosmetics Regulations 1984

terms.bm: Peraturan di bawah Akta Jualan Dadah 1952 yang mengawal ubat dan kosmetik.
terms.en: Rules under the Sale of Drugs Act 1952 that control medicines and cosmetics.
terms.source: Control of Drugs and Cosmetics Regulations 1984 (made under the Sale of Drugs Act 1952, Act 368)

terms.bm: Fail maklumat dan bukti keselamatan kosmetik, disimpan syarikat dan ditunjukkan kepada NPRA bila diminta.
terms.en: A cosmetic's technical and safety file, kept by the company for NPRA on request.
terms.source: NPRA FAQ and Cosmetic Guidelines (PIF under Article 8 of the ASEAN Cosmetic Directive)

terms.bm: Syarikat yang memaklumkan NPRA tentang sesuatu kosmetik dan bertanggungjawab menyediakan maklumat yang diminta NPRA.
terms.en: The company that notified a cosmetic to NPRA and must answer NPRA's requests.
terms.source: NPRA, Guidelines for Control of Cosmetic Products in Malaysia, section 3.0 Regulatory Requirements for Cosmetics

terms.bm: Sistem dalam talian NPRA untuk menghantar notifikasi kosmetik dan menyemak statusnya.
terms.en: NPRA's online system for submitting cosmetic notifications and checking their status.
terms.source: NPRA, Guidelines for Control of Cosmetic Products in Malaysia, section 2.0; NPRA announcement on the QUEST3 cosmetic module

terms.bm: Nombor yang NPRA beri kepada produk kosmetik yang telah dinotifikasi.
terms.en: The number NPRA gives a cosmetic product once it has been notified.
terms.source: NPRA, Guidelines for Control of Cosmetic Products in Malaysia; NPRA cosmetic notification records

terms.bm: Nombor pendaftaran yang diberi PBKD kepada ubat atau produk semula jadi yang berdaftar.
terms.en: The registration number given to a registered medicine or natural product.
terms.source: NPRA, Drug Registration Guidance Document (DRGD); NPRA registered product search

terms.bm: Dokumen panduan NPRA untuk mendaftar ubat dan produk berkaitan di Malaysia.
terms.en: NPRA's guidance document for registering medicines and related products in Malaysia.
terms.source: NPRA, Drug Registration Guidance Document (DRGD), npra.gov.my

terms.bm: Kelulusan PBKD untuk ubat atau produk semula jadi sebelum dijual. Berbeza daripada notifikasi kosmetik.
terms.en: Approval by the Drug Control Authority before a medicine is sold, unlike cosmetic notification.
terms.source: Control of Drugs and Cosmetics Regulations 1984; NPRA, Drug Registration Guidance Document

terms.bm: Perjanjian ASEAN yang menyelaraskan peraturan kosmetik antara negara anggota.
terms.en: The ASEAN agreement that aligns cosmetic rules across its member countries.
terms.source: ASEAN Cosmetic Directive; NPRA, Guidelines for Control of Cosmetic Products in Malaysia

terms.bm: Bahan yang tidak boleh ada dalam kosmetik langsung, disenaraikan dalam Annex II ACD.
terms.en: A substance banned from cosmetics, listed in Annex II of the ACD.
terms.source: ASEAN Cosmetic Directive, Annex II; NPRA Guidelines for Control of Cosmetic Products, Annex II

terms.bm: Senarai bahan yang dibenarkan dalam kosmetik hanya dengan had atau syarat tertentu.
terms.en: The list of substances allowed in cosmetics only within set limits or conditions.
terms.source: ASEAN Cosmetic Directive, Annex III; NPRA Guidelines for Control of Cosmetic Products, Annex III

terms.bm: Senarai pewarna yang dibenarkan dalam kosmetik.
terms.en: The list of colourants allowed in cosmetics.
terms.source: ASEAN Cosmetic Directive, Annex IV; NPRA Guidelines for Control of Cosmetic Products, Annex IV

terms.bm: Senarai pengawet yang dibenarkan dalam kosmetik, dengan had.
terms.en: The list of preservatives allowed in cosmetics, with limits.
terms.source: ASEAN Cosmetic Directive, Annex VI; NPRA Guidelines for Control of Cosmetic Products, Annex VI

terms.bm: Senarai penapis UV yang dibenarkan dalam kosmetik, dengan had.
terms.en: The list of UV filters allowed in cosmetics, with limits.
terms.source: ASEAN Cosmetic Directive, Annex VII; NPRA Guidelines for Control of Cosmetic Products, Annex VII

terms.bm: Bahan yang disenaraikan di bawah Akta Racun 1952 dan bekalannya dikawal.
terms.en: A substance listed under the Poisons Act 1952 whose supply is controlled.
terms.source: Poisons Act 1952 (Act 366) and its Poisons List

terms.bm: Nama bahan kosmetik yang dipiawaikan di seluruh dunia, seperti yang tertera pada label.
terms.en: The standard international name of a cosmetic ingredient, as printed on the label.
terms.source: International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients; Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009, Article 19

terms.bm: Amalan pembuatan baik: mengeluarkan dan mengawal produk mengikut piawaian kualiti yang konsisten.
terms.en: Good Manufacturing Practice: making and controlling products to consistent quality standards.
terms.source: ISO 22716 (cosmetics GMP); PIC/S Guide to GMP for medicinal products

terms.bm: Laporan makmal tentang keputusan ujian untuk satu kelompok bahan atau produk.
terms.en: A lab report with the test results for one batch.
terms.source: general meaning; used in the PIF and supplier documents

terms.bm: Dokumen pembekal tentang bahaya sesuatu bahan kimia dan cara mengendalikannya.
terms.en: A supplier's document on a chemical's hazards and how to handle it.
terms.source: DOSH, Industry Code of Practice on Chemicals Classification and Hazard Communication (Part 3, SDS)

terms.bm: Portal EU tempat kosmetik dimaklumkan sebelum dijual di pasaran EU.
terms.en: The EU portal where cosmetics are notified before they are sold in the EU.
terms.source: Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009, Article 13 (Cosmetic Products Notification Portal)

terms.bm: Jawatankuasa saintifik EU yang menasihati Suruhanjaya Eropah tentang keselamatan bahan kosmetik.
terms.en: The EU scientific committee advising the European Commission on cosmetic ingredient safety.
terms.source: European Commission, Scientific Committee on Consumer Safety (SCCS)

terms.bm: Dos tertinggi dalam kajian toksikologi yang tidak menunjukkan kesan buruk yang dapat dilihat.
terms.en: The highest dose in a toxicology study that showed no observable harmful effect.
terms.source: SCCS Notes of Guidance for the Testing of Cosmetic Ingredients and their Safety Evaluation

terms.bm: Nisbah antara dos tanpa kesan buruk (NOAEL) dan pendedahan sebenar pengguna.
terms.en: The ratio of the no-effect dose (NOAEL) to the user's actual exposure.
terms.source: SCCS Notes of Guidance for the Testing of Cosmetic Ingredients and their Safety Evaluation

terms.bm: Ukuran perlindungan daripada sinar UVB, diuji dengan kaedah piawai.
terms.en: A measure of protection from UVB rays, tested by a standard method.
terms.source: ISO 24444 (in vivo determination of the sun protection factor)

terms.bm: Sijil rasmi yang mengesahkan produk atau premis memenuhi syarat halal Malaysia.
terms.en: The official certificate confirming a product or premises meets Malaysian halal requirements.
terms.source: Manual Prosedur Pensijilan Halal Malaysia (Domestik) 2020; halal.gov.my

terms.bm: Jabatan Kemajuan Islam Malaysia, yang mengurus pensijilan halal bersama jabatan agama negeri.
terms.en: Malaysia's Department of Islamic Development, which runs halal certification with state religious departments.
terms.source: halal.gov.my (Bahagian Pengurusan Halal, JAKIM)

terms.bm: Logo rasmi pada pembungkusan yang hanya boleh digunakan oleh pemegang sijil halal yang sah.
terms.en: The official logo on packaging that only a valid halal certificate holder may use.
terms.source: Manual Prosedur Pensijilan Halal Malaysia (Domestik) 2020; halal.gov.my

terms.bm: Bahagian Keselamatan dan Kualiti Makanan KKM, yang menguatkuasakan Akta Makanan 1983.
terms.en: The Ministry of Health's food safety division, which enforces the Food Act 1983.
terms.source: Food Act 1983 (Act 281); myfsq.moh.gov.my

terms.bm: Undang-undang utama di Malaysia untuk keselamatan, mutu dan label makanan.
terms.en: Malaysia's main law on the safety, quality and labelling of food.
terms.source: Food Act 1983 (Act 281) and Food Regulations 1985

terms.bm: Sistem mengenal pasti dan mengawal bahaya keselamatan makanan pada setiap langkah pengeluaran.
terms.en: A system for finding and controlling food safety hazards at each production step.
terms.source: Codex Alimentarius, General Principles of Food Hygiene (CXC 1-1969), HACCP annex

terms.bm: Skim jaminan keselamatan makanan KKM untuk pengilang makanan: Makanan Selamat Tanggungjawab Industri.
terms.en: The Ministry of Health's food safety assurance scheme for food manufacturers.
terms.source: KKM, Food Safety and Quality Programme (moh.gov.my); Food Hygiene Regulations 2009

terms.bm: Kebolehan menjejak produk atau bahan daripada sumber hingga ke pengguna melalui rekod.
terms.en: The ability to follow a product or ingredient from source to consumer through records.
terms.source: Codex Alimentarius, Principles for Traceability / Product Tracing (CXG 60-2006)

terms.bm: Bahan yang boleh mencetuskan reaksi alahan pada sesetengah orang.
terms.en: A substance that can trigger an allergic reaction in some people.
terms.source: general meaning; Food Regulations 1985 (labelling of food allergens)

terms.bm: Disiarkan secara rasmi dalam warta kerajaan.
terms.en: Officially published in the government gazette.
terms.source: general meaning

terms.bm: Menarik balik produk yang sudah dijual daripada pasaran dan pengguna.
terms.en: Taking an already-sold product back off the market and from consumers.
terms.source: general meaning; NPRA and BKKM recall notices

terms.bm: Surat edaran rasmi agensi kerajaan untuk memaklumkan arahan atau peraturan.
terms.en: An official notice from a government agency announcing an instruction or rule.
terms.source: general meaning

terms.bm: Dokumen rasmi yang menerangkan cara mematuhi sesuatu peraturan.
terms.en: An official document explaining how to comply with a rule.
terms.source: general meaning

terms.bm: Kementerian Kesihatan Malaysia, yang menyelia ubat, kosmetik dan keselamatan makanan.
terms.en: The Ministry of Health Malaysia, which oversees medicines, cosmetics and food safety.
terms.source: moh.gov.my
